datasets.schedule: exact parent scheduled/completed frame lists, poses, intrinsics, depth and vocabulary

baseline.source: same parent map/receipt, not rounded historical table values

fixed.visual_models: parent native SigLIP and FC_FROZEN; same weights/preprocessing/templates

weight_rule.partial_sources: exact inherited available-source behavior, independent of gamma

recovery.order: descending residual source-row count, then canonical world-coordinate support digest
recovery.request_proof: all recorded segments converge to exactly one active final RAW owner using captured aliases
recovery.U1: exactly one successful retained native observation, with matching physical request and final-owner proof
recovery.UQ: frozen query_scores availability plus final-lineage receipt; no extra query acquisition
recovery.U2: same candidate/request as U1; one FC view, no alternate-view substitution
recovery.U3: all capped candidates with legal captured requests; top three by area then frame and physical request key
recovery.U3_failure: omit recovered owner, no fallback masquerading as FC
recovery.FC_frame_budget_assignment: rank candidate requests before inference; skip uncached frames beyond cap, no lower-ranked substitute
recovery.paired_evaluation: U1/U2 common successful subset plus full pipeline coverage separately
recovery.cache_inventory: freeze before the recovery comparison; new admissions shared, no retroactive cap expansion

association.A1: reuse old forward eligible/benefit solve exactly; unmatched => USE_NATIVE
association.A2: same eligible forward edges; rowwise best, no global capacity constraint; unmatched => USE_NATIVE
association.many_to_one_means: several local groups may share one existing owner; no forced existing-owner merges

sam.inputs: cached per-track binary masks + recorded RAW winner raster + current CropFormer; no full logits assumed
sam.match_rule: mutual unique best IoU; tied maxima => unattached; spatial order is for output determinism only
sam.protect: all currently CropFormer-labeled pixels and their separate groups
sam.attached_completion: recorded RAW winner pixels only on CropFormer-background, attached to matched CropFormer group
sam.S2_reject_action: drop only offending SAM-origin additions; retain original CropFormer pixels
sam.S2_state: own current preinsert map plus two past snapshots; never final/other experimental map for online decisions

screening.S1_gate: at least one changed canonical frontend raster over all development frames; otherwise equivalent input control
screening.S2_gate: S1 has a real intervention and cached tracks are available; implement/run own-map conditional path

geometric_catastrophe.action: SCREENED_OUT_GEOMETRY; publish full geometry; do not spend N/Q/FC on that arm

screening.relative_baseline: same frozen BB00 native map, not failed prior FORWARD/BIDIR

selection.tie: standalone new encoder inputs, changed blocks, parameter distance to baseline, fixed method ID
selection.map_transfer_gate: candidate has NET_GAIN on four development scenes under fixed D2 and is not geometric-catastrophe

composition.light: one selected gamma x one selected recovery rule; additionally compare each component
composition.geometry: one qualifying map finalist x frozen light package; no A/S Cartesian product

limits.note: recovery cap covers at most 40 scene/applications (parent12 + new28); actual usually much lower

evaluation.overlaps: read actual pinned evaluator vector, no assumed COCO .95 endpoint
evaluation.projection: same coordinates reuse; changed geometry recompute
evaluation.rank: recompute for all exported owners after recovery, including old owners

publication.remote_verify: normal git push then full local HEAD equals remote refs/heads branch SHA
publication.external_receipt: publication/final.json outside commit; no self-referential hash claim
publication.commit_arrays: compact class scores/probabilities and actual interventions; no weights/RGB-D/full TSDF
